name: Checklist for EPI Support Supervision at Health Facilities - MOH/RSS South Sudan
description: Full EPI Support Supervision Checklist for Health Facilities, Ministry of Health / Republic of South Sudan. Covers General Information, EPI Plan, Session Observations, Monitoring and Supervision, Waste Management and Injection Safety, VPD Surveillance, Community Mobilization, Support from Higher Level, Observations by Supervisor, Client Exit Interview, and Supervision Summary.

questions.sectionTitle: III. EPI Routine Immunization Session Observations
questions.questionText: [3.1.] Are the vaccine and diluents brought to the session in a small plastic bag, under a foam pad, in a vaccine carrier with four conditioned ice packs?

questions.sectionTitle: III. EPI Routine Immunization Session Observations

questions.questionText: [3.4.] Are there sufficient syringes/needles for reconstituting and administering the vaccines?

questions.questionText: [3.7.] Are used needles and syringes immediately placed in a safety box following administration of the vaccine?

questions.questionText: [3.8.] Does the vaccinator deliver all the five (5) key messages of immunization to parents/care-givers?

Were the clients told to keep the card safe and bring it for vaccination? (Number of 'Yes' responses out of 5 clients)
